caption: The video captures a fixed close-up of a forest stream cascading over a rounded central boulder, the flow already running throughout. A thin sheet of water spills from the top into a shimmering film across the wet rock, where vertical rivulets trace shifting paths as it descends. At the lower left and center the water breaks into churning white foam that keeps bubbling and reforming, its boundary shifting slightly. Moss-covered rocks flank the right and a decaying log rests at the upper left, while green plants and pine needles line the bank. On the right a calmer dark pool holds floating leaves, its surface disturbed now and then by small ripple rings that appear and fade. A single orange-yellow leaf between the cascade and the mossy boulder stays fixed, as do the green leaf on the lower rock and the stones. The camera remains still, so only the moving water alters the scene.
